title: agentmark.toml
description: Project configuration for an AgentMark project.

name.description: Project name; also the name of the built binary.

targets.description: Compilation targets. Only "rust" exists in v0.x.

lint.description: Style rules. Rules listed under deny are errors instead of warnings.

deny.description: Lint rules promoted from warnings to errors.

rust.description: Settings for the generated Rust project.

dependencies.description: Copied verbatim into [dependencies] of the generated Cargo.toml. Each entry is a version text or a Cargo dependency table.

crates.description: Extra Rust crates for the generated project (SPEC 22.4). Each entry is a version string, or a table with an optional version and optional features.

model_actions.description: Enable the optional model-backed code actions (explain this block, suggest a guard). Off by default.

models.description: Maps an environment name to a model driver string (SPEC 19). Any environment name is allowed; production, test and dev are the usual ones.

local.description: Either a driver string (an environment named local) or the settings table for local:<model> drivers (any OpenAI-compatible server).

base_url.description: Base URL of the OpenAI-compatible server, for example http://localhost:11434/v1.

driver.description: A model driver string: claude, claude:<model>, openai:<model>, local:<model>, mock or mock:<path>. azure and bedrock are not supported yet.
